description: Call when you have a rights or licensing question in plain English, such as 'Can I use CC BY-NC 4.0 images in a paid ad campaign?'. Returns the license or registered resource and the use it understood, and a deterministic answer with reasons; it asks for clarification instead of guessing. Check the understood use before relying on it. Free, no key.

intended_use.description: Uses to check: each true flag must be documented; omitted = false; unknown fields refused. For instance {"commercial_use":true}

duration_days.description: Whole days of use (1 to 36500), or null for no fixed term

geography.description: worldwide (default) or a region code such as US, EU, UK

resource_id.description: Optional: pin a registered resource instead of letting the interpreter match one.

name: ask_rightshold
title: Ask Rightshold (plain English)
